basic_info.description: Step inside this distinguished Queen Anne Victorian to discover an elegantly remodeled condo with a deeded and private walkout garden.  The living room is centered around a stately fireplace, framed by two picture windows surrounded by greenery. Attached is a remodeled kitchen perfectly blending transitional and modern style, equipped with Miele appliances, thoughtful storage solutions, and an eat area in the iconic turret of the building. Past the hall closet and in-unit laundry, a spacious primary bedroom leaves room for a seating area and access to the garden through french doors. Across the hall is an updated bathroom wrapped in limestone, and a second bedroom/office with french doors. A condo rarity, this exclusive garden is a magical place to reset and entertain, south-facing and lush in greenery. Additionally, the unit offers a one-car garage with great storage. Ideally located between Buena Vista and Golden Gate Park, steps to Cole Valley and the center of Haight Ashbury, this location has it all.
